name: badb-event-bot
description: Bay Area Droid Builders - Google Form to Discord event bot

scripts.deploy:form-submit: npm run build && gcloud functions deploy badb-form-submit --gen2 --runtime=nodejs24 --region=us-west1 --source=. --entry-point=formSubmit --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --env-vars-file=.env.yaml
scripts.deploy:interactions: npm run build && gcloud functions deploy badb-interactions --gen2 --runtime=nodejs24 --region=us-west1 --source=. --entry-point=interactions --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances=1 --env-vars-file=.env.yaml
scripts.deploy:poll-scheduled-events: npm run build && gcloud functions deploy badb-poll-scheduled-events --gen2 --runtime=nodejs24 --region=us-west1 --source=. --entry-point=pollScheduledEvents --trigger-http --no-allow-unauthenticated --env-vars-file=.env.yaml
scripts.deploy:send-event-digest: npm run build && gcloud functions deploy badb-send-event-digest --gen2 --runtime=nodejs24 --region=us-west1 --source=. --entry-point=sendEventDigest --trigger-http --no-allow-unauthenticated --env-vars-file=.env.yaml
scripts.deploy:rsvp: npm run build && gcloud functions deploy badb-rsvp --gen2 --runtime=nodejs24 --region=us-west1 --source=. --entry-point=rsvp --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --env-vars-file=.env.yaml
